input.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: § 3.2 auto-renews each Service Option Attachment for a term equal in duration to the prior term, so a multi-year initial term (set in the Order Form under § 3.1) renews automatically for another multi-year period — a walk-away item. The non-renewal notice window is 90 days, at the outer walk-away limit and well beyond the preferred 30 days (fallback 60). There is also no cap on renewal Charges: § 4.1 leaves Charges to the Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, so renewal pricing is unconstrained. Redline sets a 12-month renewal term, a 30-day Customer non-renewal notice (IBM retains 90 days), a 60-day IBM renewal reminder, and caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

proposal.summary: Set renewal term at 12 months, cut Customer's non-renewal notice to 30 days, add IBM renewal reminder and cap renewal price increases
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have set renewals at 12 months, reduced our non-renewal notice to 30 days (IBM retains 90 days), and added a 60-day renewal reminder plus a cap on renewal price increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%, so renewals stay easy to exit and predictably priced. If helpful, we can accept a 60-day notice window and a 5% uplift cap as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
ops.newText: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term of twelve (12) months unless (i) Customer notifies IBM in writing at least thirty (30) days, or (ii) IBM notifies Customer in writing at least ninety (90) days, prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected not to renew such Service Option Attachment. IBM will notify Customer in writing at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term of the upcoming renewal and of any proposed change in Charges. Charges for any renewal term will not exceed the Charges in effect during the immediately preceding term by more than the lesser of (a) the percentage increase in the U.S. Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers over the preceding twelve (12) months and (b) three percent (3%).
